newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says business outlook stronger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says business outlook stronger.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday that the outlook for business investment has strengthened.
Costello said the inflation outcome for 1996/97 to June 30 could be even better than the latest forecast, while he expected wages growth of 4.5 percent in 1996/97.

"To the extent that recent inflation outcomes reflect a faster than usual rate of exchange rate pass-through into retail prices, inflation outcomes could be even better in 1996/97 but higher than forecast in 1997/98," Costello said.
In the government's mid-year budget reviewed released on Tuesday, the business investment forecast was revised upwards to 17 percent from 14 percent forecast in the August budget.
In the review, Costello revised down the forecast for underlying inflation in the fiscal year to June 30, 1997, against the 2.75 percent projected in the August budget.
The Treasury's underlying measure of inflation excludes items whose prices are highly volatile, exhibit marked seasonal patterns, or are largely effected by policy decisions.
These items include meat, clothing, tobacco, alchohol, holiday travel and accomodation, fuel health services local government charges and education.
